checks.command: ruff check services/maintenance.py tests/test_maintenance_path_confinement.py; ruff format --check services/maintenance.py tests/test_maintenance_path_confinement.py

supported_claims: Maintenance path checking rejects traversal and absolute paths, rejects a symlink root, and rejects existing symlink components.
Upload validation rejects traversal-like client filenames and unsupported media types before storage.
Malformed media and decoder failure paths retain bounded failure reporting and do not publish partial normalized audio.
Model cache inventory rejects symlinks and hostile filenames remain metadata, not model evidence.
limitations: The test host cannot create directory symlinks, so the symlink rejection test is skipped.
The code does not provide an atomic no-follow open/delete primitive; concurrent symlink replacement races are not proven safe.
Three media tests were skipped by the local media/tool availability guards.
